content.title: GameStop Stock Jumps as Retailer, White House Trade Halo Memes
content.summary: GameStop  shares jumped higher in early Monday trading and are set to open at the highest levels in three weeks, as investors reacted to a series of messages and images indicating potentially solid demand for  Microsoft’s  newest game release.  A similarly playful image of President Donald Trump released by the White House, depicting him as a character in Microsoft’s upcoming release of Halo: Campaign Evolved, was also taken as support for GameStop’s broader marketing effort.  Halo: Campaign Evolved, a reworked version of the 2001 original Halo: Combat evolved, will be released on both Microsoft’s Xbox gaming console as well as the  Sony  -owned PlayStation 5 for the first time.
